info.title: v2.public.refresh_access_token
info.description: Use this API to refresh the access_token after it expires. Refresh_token can be used once only, this API will also return a new refresh_token. Please use the new refresh_token for the next RefreshAccessToken call

post.description: Use this API to refresh the access_token after it expires. Refresh_token can be used once only, this API will also return a new refresh_token. Please use the new refresh_token for the next RefreshAccessToken call

parameters.name: merchant_id
parameters.description: The merchant_id that granted authorization to your App. Only the shop_id or merchant_id or supplier_id or user_id can be selected as the input parameter, and they must be refreshed separately.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: principal_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a principal.

parameters.name: refresh_token
parameters.description: Use refresh_token to get a new access_token. Each refresh_token is valid for 30 days, and can only be used once by either a shop_id or merchant_id or supplier_id or user_id.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: The shop_id that granted authorization to your App. Only the shop_id or merchant_id or supplier_id or user_id can be selected as the input parameter, and they must be refreshed separately.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: supplier_id
parameters.description: The supplier_id that granted authorization to your App. Only the shop_id or merchant_id or supplier_id or user_id can be selected as the input parameter, and they must be refreshed separately.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: The user_id that granted authorization to your App. Only the shop_id or merchant_id or supplier_id or user_id can be selected as the input parameter, and they must be refreshed separately.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/auth/access_token/get?partner_id=partner_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "partner_id": 2001887,
    "refresh_token": "4c7259534969484e71734d695a6e6d55",
    "shop_id": 322300222
}',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
